title: Luxury Downtown River Front Condo with Pool
description:
Experience the perfect blend of relaxation and city excitement at this peaceful riverside apartment, just moments from the heart of Downtown Broadway! Overlooking the Cumberland River, this stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom retreat offers a serene escape while keeping you close to all the action. Wake up to a waterfront view, spend your day exploring Nashville’s vibrant scene, and come home to unwind in a peaceful, upscale setting.

Guest access
You will receive check in instructions and your smart-lock code 24 hours before your stay. This code is unique to your stay and is only active during your reservation day/times.
